git.admin_description: Manage the GitHub App, approved repositories, and cache state.
git.generic_error: Unable to load this Git view
git.generic_error_description: The view could not be rendered. Retry the request, or return to the repository.
git.github_unavailable: GitHub did not complete this request
git.github_unavailable_description: GitHub returned an access or service error. This is not being reported as a rate limit.
git.rate_limited_description: GitHub explicitly reported that its API limit was exhausted or throttled. Try again after the limit resets.
git.repository_not_found_description: This repository is not registered, is private, or is currently unavailable.

ws-roles.manage_git_repositories_description: Allows platform administrators to configure the GitHub App and approve public repositories for Git.
